consequence.statement: Environments that rely on the previous compareoptions defaults rather than setting them explicitly get the new default values after upgrading to 3.0.0, so the product behaves differently with unchanged configuration; the upstream commit is marked as a breaking change (feat!).
consequence.remediation: Review upstream change #22230 (commit cca748591737d568e5b976cb060b960c40bd8c14) for the new defaults and verify Argo CD behavior after upgrading if the compareoptions settings are not set explicitly.

assertion.statement: The v3.0.0 release notes state that a breaking-change-marked feature (commit cca748591737d568e5b976cb060b960c40bd8c14, #22230) updates the default values of the compareoptions settings, without specifying which options changed or the old and new values.
